evaluations.reason: The dispatcher now evaluates targetMismatchEnvelopeForInput immediately after parsing/building hook context and before command module loading, pre hooks/validation, command execution, runtime metadata persistence setup, and lifecycle mutations. On mismatch it emits an ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH envelope, exits, and returns before any flowManager updateStepStatus or setStepRuntimeLog call can occur. Added regression coverage also asserts run ID, issue, and spec mismatches do not validate, execute, persist metadata, or change flow/task step statuses.
